verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents its own HTTP and WebSocket API: the Agent Server runs the SDK behind it, the pricing page lists 'API support for automation and scripting', and a published OpenAPI spec exists. UI-style flows such as conversation goals with stop/resume are documented as agent-server capabilities. Nothing states that the API covers everything the UI can do, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement or coverage mapping, evidence that UI features like automations, integrations and settings are reachable via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
